_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-03 (late), BEFORE any forward data exists. Do not edit to fit a result. To change a criterion, add a dated entry to docs/research/log.md saying why, then edit.
purpose: The only evidence that cannot be overfitted: judge frozen rules on data that did not exist when they were fixed. The historical test of the same rules (evidence/mean_reversion_etf.json) FAILED its registered verdict but survived costs; a pass here would be new evidence, a fail would close the idea.
frozen_rules: Exactly the four variants of evidence/mean_reversion_etf.json, unchanged: RSI(2) on SPY, IBS on SPY, RSI(2) on QQQ, IBS on QQQ. No new variants, no changed thresholds, no filters.
start: Flat from the close of 2026-11-03. A variant enters only on a signal change from 0 to 1 decided at a close on or after the freeze date; a signal that is already 1 at the freeze date is ignored until it has gone back to 0. Fills at the next open, as in the historical test.
costs: tempo.backtest.Costs commission and the SEC fee, plus 3 bps per side slippage (the historical stress level, not the 1 bp base)
how_to_run: python -m tempo.data SPY --ohlc ; python -m tempo.data QQQ --ohlc ; python -m tempo.forward
no_reading_into_small_samples: No verdict is allowed before the pooled count of completed round trips across the four variants reaches 60, or 2028-11-03, whichever comes first. Until then the report shows counts and averages with the label NOT ENOUGH TRIPS and nothing else is concluded.
pass_all_of_at_evaluation: pooled average net return per completed round trip (after costs and 3 bps slippage per side) is above 0.10%
t-statistic of the pooled per-trip net returns is above 2.0
no single variant contributes more than 60% of the pooled round trips' total profit (not one lucky variant)
reported_not_criteria: each variant's trips, average net per trip, win rate
net CAGR and Sharpe of each variant over the forward window against SPY or QQQ buy and hold over the same window
if_fail: Report it as a failure and close the mean reversion family: stop spending effort on it.
if_pass: Still not real money: next step is the gate in evidence/gate.json (paper trading with measured fills through tempo/orders.py, employer and tax checks).
